proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12064.3 bukka gives Oriya buka breast and buku heart/chest, with Assamese buk/buku breast. These eastern breast forms belong to the bukka branch, not the vṛkka kidney head; Turner discusses a non-Aryan deeper origin and semantic contamination. Exact survey form buk is preserved.
